messages:
Sylvia: RFC follow-up — Progressive Uncoupling for the enrichment pipeline. Proposal summary: introduce a 'quarantine lane' to host legacy/fragile enrichers behind a light shim so we can gradually pay down tech debt without global rollbacks. Phases attached. Looking for ops + infra concerns before I fold into the RFC doc.

Maya: sounds good. can you clarify the traffic splitting model? is this per-tenant or per-request? :eyes:

Sylvia: per-tenant is preferred for isolation, but we could start with a per-route sample to validate behaviour. primary goals: avoid blast radius, keep predictable p95.

Kevin: main concern is tail latency and cascading timeouts. sidecar approach adds hop. do we have SLO headroom on the hot path?

Lia: also need to decide KV cache ownership. if we put shim in front, who warms/stores the KV? otherwise we'll spike cold starts during cutover.

Jasper: ops checklist idea: start with 5 low-risk tenants for 48h, monitor p95/p99 & error budget, then increment. fallback rule = immediate reroute to canonical pipeline on any error surge.

Omar: question about adapters: are they going to be "protocol adapters" (translate old API) or lightweight wrappers? adapters add maintenance cost but reduce long-term surface.

Sylvia: adapters = thin compatibility wrappers (translate input/output), goal is short-lived (6–12mo) while teams migrate. we keep metrics & structured logs to detect behaviour drift.

Maya: can we get a short experiment plan? even a 5-step runbook would help platform to approve quota changes.

Sylvia: yes — quick runbook below (first draft):

```
Phase 0 - Inventory
- enumerate enrichers, requests/sec, p95/p99, failure modes
Phase 1 - Quarantine shim (read-through)
- deploy shim per-region, route 5-10% tenant traffic
- metrics: latency, errors, percent-missed-cache
Phase 2 - Adapter rollout
- add adapters for top 3 enrichers by qps
- route 25% -> 50% over 2w, observe
Phase 3 - Cohort expansion
- expand tenants by factor 5 each week, auto-fallback enabled
Phase 4 - Cutover & decommission
- final validation -> switch 100% -> mark old enrichers deprecated
```

Lia: looks good. add explicit step for KV ownership: create a feature-flagged cache-proxy mode so we can toggle where state lives.

Kevin: also add a chaos step: simulated node flaps and added latency to shim to validate resilience. if p99 increases > 2x then rollback.

Jasper: ops will need a cost estimate. quarantine lanes = extra CPUs for shims + adapter containers. I'll draft a rough monthly delta.

infra-bot: deploy-notify: RFC doc updated at https://redwood.internal/rfcs/PR-678 (Sylvia). Latest diff includes runbook + metric dashboard links.

Omar: risk matrix idea (quick):
- Risk: degraded p95 -> Mitigation: staged cohort + circuit-breaker
- Risk: cache miss surge -> Mitigation: warmup jobs + feature flag for cache-proxy
- Risk: adapter regressions -> Mitigation: schema validation + contract tests

Maya: can we add one more acceptance gate: "no more than 5% increase in tail latency for cohort tenants". If exceeded, freeze expansion for 24h.

Sylvia: agreed. i'll add it. thanks for the quick feedback — i'll iterate the RFC and ping product/sre for signoff. @Jasper please attach cost delta when you have it.

Jasper: on it, will post numbers tomorrow morning. :+1:

Omar: one operational note — ensure rollbacks are automated via route-police jobs, not manual. we've had too many slow manual cutbacks.

Sylvia: excellent point. adding automated fallback to runbook (priority precondition).

Maya: lgtm, please include a short eval harness for quality regression (prompt sets + synthetic traffic). otherwise teams will ship adapters with subtle semantic drift.

Sylvia: will do. thanks everyone. closing loop after next doc revision.
